service.on: It goes back on sale in the POS and the customer app.
service.off: It disappears from the POS and the customer app. Its data and past orders are kept.

outlet.on: The outlet takes orders again and shows in the app.
outlet.off: The outlet takes no orders and is hidden from the app.

material.on: It can be picked for recipes and stock again.
material.off: It cannot be picked for new recipes or stock. Existing ones are kept.

banner.on: Once active, it shows whenever its schedule allows.
banner.off: It stops showing in the app. It is kept and can be turned on again.

voucher.on: Customers can claim and use it again, whenever its window allows.
voucher.off: Customers can no longer claim or use it. Wallets that hold it keep it, and it can be turned on again.
